rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.00225, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-17 LAMBDA peak refinement (fine). iter-16 (lambda=2.5e-3) hr=0.36285 NEW BEST, beating 3e-3 (0.3596) and 2e-3 (0.3552) => peak bracketed at 2.5e-3 (2e-3<2.5e-3>3e-3). ONE knob: tv_lambda 2.5e-3->2.25e-3 (test the low side of the bracket). HYPOTHESIS: if hr>0.36285 the peak is between 2e-3 and 2.5e-3; if hr<0.36285 the peak is at/above 2.5e-3 and 0.3628 stands as the plain-TV optimum. Also verifies the just-applied solver save-fix: recon_raw.npz should now have keys pred+truth+baseline with truth=real phantom (per-case mean ~0.13, not ~0.067). Best config otherwise: gamma=1, 1000it, gd, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, fbp init. Budget: ~830s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
